## Où j'en suis
`cmd/replay` is written, with a dry run, per-partition ordering, a rejects file, and a topic allowlist that only allows `events.replay.v3`. The dry run on the 12/11 window (14:10–17:40 UTC) found 18,442,107 events to replay, none already in the dedup store, and 3,118 schema v2 lines written to the rejects file. PR #233 is open with Daniel as reviewer. The real replay and the aggregator `--backfill` have not run yet.

- [prochaine-étape] Daniel reviews PR #233
- [prochaine-étape] Real replay into `events.replay.v3` with `--batch 5000`
- [prochaine-étape] Run the aggregator `--backfill` for 2026-11-12
- [question] Rachel needs an ETA by Friday for Fernhill and Orbitly. The user will give it after Daniel's review.
- [essai-raté] `--batch 50000` got the pod OOMKilled (2 GiB limit, ~2.6 GiB peak). Fixed with `--batch 5000`, peak 310 MiB. The memory limit was left alone because of the namespace quota.
- [essai-raté] Four parallel workers broke per-partition order (`TestStreamWindow_OrderWithinPartition`). Fixed by assigning each `part-NNN` to one worker.
- [essai-raté] Dropping events older than 72h was rejected, since the backfill recomputes the aggregates and nothing should be dropped.
- [décision] Replay everything into `events.replay.v3`, never `events.v3` from this tool, with no age cutoff (source: t05)
- [décision] Batch size 5000, memory limit unchanged (source: t13)
- [décision] Malformed lines go to `replay-rejects` in the bucket instead of being skipped silently (source: t15)
